allowed_when: Final or aborted bounded run only; no interactive per-step tuning feedback during execution.

required_fields.run_id: Public authorized execution identity, not private case identity
required_fields.broad_failure_codes: Unique array from the fixed enum; empty allowed
required_fields.generation_attempts_spent: Integer from zero through the frozen total ceiling
required_fields.mandatory_steps_accounted: Aggregate integer from zero through the mandatory graph size
required_fields.mandatory_steps_incomplete: Aggregate integer from zero through the mandatory graph size
required_fields.all_mandatory_assertions_passed: Boolean true only from accepted independent complete scoring
required_fields.retained_evaluation_bundle_sha256: Aggregate bundle digest only; no individual private request digests
